text: With the freshness number signed off, this video draws a hard line around version one -- before 'can it also forecast?' quietly becomes part of the build.
V1 ships exactly two Gold models: near-real-time depletion by store and SKU, and a nightly sales rollup for leadership. Both answer what's happening right now.
Demand forecasting, automated reordering, and inter-store transfers are real ideas -- deferred to v2, with reasons written down, not silently dropped.
When Carol asks for forecasting mid-build, the answer isn't no -- it's yes, in v2, here's what pulling it into v1 costs. She picks the tradeoff herself, in writing.
Next: choosing the exact tools that move and process this data continuously, not once a night.
